_readme: Weapons. statMultipliers scale the Adventurer's base stats (1.5 = 150%); stats not listed stay at 100%. skills are granted while equipped; the first one is the basic attack (also used for opportunity attacks and by 'weapon'-tagged skills). tag is the short label drawn on battle tokens; art is the weapon sprite (public/art/weapons/<art>.svg).

sword_shield.name: Sword & Shield
sword_shield.description: Frontline weapon. High Defense; locks enemies in melee and shields itself.

spear.name: Spear
spear.description: Reach weapon. Hits from 2 tiles, knocks foes back and guards approaches.

bow.name: Bow
bow.description: Ranged weapon. Shoots from afar, lobs arrows over cover and watches lanes.

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: Magic focus. Strikes mix physical and magic power; pairs with Mage skills.
